product_overview: Veterinary SaaS Platform is a comprehensive web application designed to streamline veterinary clinic operations. Built on modern technologies such as Next.js, React, and Supabase, it provides a secure, single-tenant solution for managing clients, patients, appointments, clinical records, inventory, billing, communications, boarding, tasks, and staff time tracking with an emphasis on usability and real-time operations.
core_goals: Empower veterinary clinics to manage all aspects of their operations in a single platform.
Automate administrative tasks like scheduling, billing, and inventory management to increase clinic efficiency.
Ensure secure, role-based access and data integrity across all clinic data and processes.
Deliver real-time operational insights and notifications to support effective decision-making.
Provide an intuitive and accessible user interface optimized for various devices and accessibility needs.
key_features: User authentication and session management with Supabase Auth.
Comprehensive dashboard with real-time analytics and quick action shortcuts.
Client and patient management featuring detailed pet health histories and multi-pet household support.
Visual appointment scheduling with conflict detection, recurring booking, and automated reminders.
Clinical records management using structured SOAP notes, prescription tracking, and diagnostic results storage.
Inventory and vaccination tracking with stock levels, low stock alerts, and protocol management.
Billing system including invoice generation, payment processing, insurance claims, and financial reporting.
Multi-channel communication center supporting email, SMS, templates, and message history.
Boarding and hospitalization reservation system with check-in/out and medical monitoring.
Task and reminder management with priority settings, status workflows, and team collaboration.
Staff administration including time tracking, clock in/out, scheduling, and attendance reporting.
Robust reporting suite covering financial, operational, client, staff, and compliance reports.
user_flow_summary: Clinic staff authenticate via secure login to access the dashboard and clinic modules.
Practice managers add and manage client and patient records, including medical histories and vaccination details.
Appointments are scheduled and managed via a calendar interface with automated conflict detection and reminders sent to clients.
Veterinarians create and update clinical records using structured SOAP notes and track prescriptions.
Inventory managers update stock levels and receive alerts for low inventory or expiring products.
Billing staff generate invoices, process payments, and track revenue through the financial dashboard.
Communications staff send messages to clients through email or SMS using customizable templates and review message history.
Boarding services staff reserve, check-in, and monitor patients admitted for boarding or hospitalization.
Tasks are assigned and tracked by staff, with notifications and status updates facilitating team coordination.
Staff members track their working hours and breaks using the time tracking tools, integrated with payroll systems.
validation_criteria: All dashboard modules (25+) must be fully functional and accessible according to user roles.
Authentication system must securely manage sessions with multi-factor support and role-based permissions.
Appointment scheduling must prevent double-bookings and support recurring appointments with automated reminders.
Clinical record entries must follow the SOAP format and allow for detailed prescription and diagnostic data entry.
Inventory and vaccination modules must accurately track stock levels, provide low stock warnings, and support protocol customization.
Billing processes must generate accurate invoices, support multiple payment methods, and integrate insurance claim processing workflows.
Communication features must log all client interactions, support email and SMS templating, and maintain history for audit.
Boarding management must maintain accurate facility capacity data, reservation statuses, and integrate billing for services rendered.
Task system must enforce priority levels, track statuses, and send automated reminders to assigned users.
Time and attendance functionality must track clock-ins, breaks, and overtime, producing accurate attendance reports.
Performance benchmarks require page loads under 2 seconds and API responses under 500ms under typical load.
Security compliance mandates encryption of sensitive data, audit logging, and adherence to HIPAA-ready practices.
Accessibility features must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards including keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
Comprehensive test coverage with unit, integration, and end-to-end tests must be in place, validated by CI/CD pipelines.
